findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - an upgrade from an adopted v1.2.2 repo adds an impeccable launcher, and an extra edit removes its executable bit before a subsequent close.
This check accepts mode 100644 for a newly added launcher because its base mode is 000000. The adopted fixture has no impeccable launcher, while sync adds one for each host and sets its mode to 755 on POSIX (`src/forge/design_skills.py:12`, `src/forge/sync.py:164`). The content comparison and the earlier sync check do not detect a mode-only change, so close skips model review and can publish a launcher that cannot run.

why: Bug 1531. Each Forge upgrade stops for the person's choice, because the model review of the upgrade fix applies the repo's review rules, a proof-list rule raises a P1, and the one-round limit is reached.
